services.value: Provides NELAP-accredited laboratory analytical services using accredited procedures based on protocols by the TCEQ, Railroad Commission, the state of New Mexico, and the EPA. Offers organic analysis (BTEX and TPH methods 8021, TX1005 and 8015 in soil and water using Gas Chromatography with PID/FID) and inorganic analysis including RCRA 8 single analyte or SAR performed by ICP using EPA method 6010.
